subject: Optional visitor suggestions: privacy and security safeguards
method: In-repository Specialists Board, offline local mode, no external AI engine or web research.

consultation.question: ما هي التشريعات والخصوصية عند جمع بيانات الزوار؟
consultation.specialistResponse: التشريعات والخصوصية تحدد واجباتك القانونية: موافقة المستخدم، وحدود الاحتفاظ بالبيانات، والإبلاغ عن الاختراقات، وحقوق أصحاب البيانات. الامتثال جزء من الأمن لا مقابل له.
consultation.specialistCaveat: The specialist agent explicitly marked this as a near miss rather than an exact answer and recorded a study gap. Its recorded flag was produced against a disposable test repository, not a production store.
consultation.disposition: Used only as general design guidance for explicit submission agreement, limited retention, and deletion controls; not treated as legal advice, security certification, or approval of this implementation.

implementationChecks: Suggestions are optional and separately confirmed; analytics consent is not required.
No visitor or account identifier is accepted into the stored record; no name or contact field is presented.
Emails, long numbers and order references are redacted; secrets and explicit personal-detail markers are refused.
Topic tags are local keywords only; suggestion text is not sent to an AI engine and no emotion profile is created.
Administrative review is manual; suggestions do not automatically change recommendations, prices or offers.

Suggestions expire at 180 days; long-running hosts clean them daily, while serverless hosts purge expired entries on the first later request. The administration can also delete a suggestion at any time.
